analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md, adding one paragraph (head lines 456-468) to the Nemotron Super section. It documents NAX-GPU (M5+) kernel routing for NVFP4 experts and dense FP8/NVFP4 projections, plus MTP verify-window submission and fused-decode env controls (DARKBLOOM_NEMOTRON_SUPER_MTP_WINDOW_SUBMIT, DARKBLOOM_NEMOTRON_SUPER_MTP_FUSION). There are no code, config, wire-protocol, key-handling, attestation, cache-storage, or authorization changes in the supplied evidence. I checked the new text against the threat model, including T-041 and the prefix-cache, attestation and App Attest boundaries. The paragraph does not alter prefix-cache scoping, the TTL, or the encrypted SSD tier. It does not touch coordinator-provider encryption (TB-002) or the App Attest authorization (TB-011). It makes no secrecy, correctness or qualification claims that overclaim (T-056). It also states that the changes do not alter tokens and that the accuracy is teacher-forced; this is a documentation assertion and I could not verify it against the underlying kernel implementation, which is outside the supplied evidence. The new env knobs are operator-local, and the DeadlineRuntimeEnvironment guard already rejects unrecognized DARKBLOOM_* settings for qualification. Whether the underlying kernel/code changes (not in this batch) introduce new surface, such as memory transients or numerical differences affecting output integrity (T-007/T-027), is not assessable here. No finding is raised.
